title: Smartphone Mid-Frame & Structural Chassis
description: Large thin-walled perimeter frame with complex internal ribbing, threaded inserts, antenna bands, and precision locator features
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers 3x the yield strength of 6061 aluminum at similar density, enabling thinner cross-sections for lighter phones with better drop protection.
Form: Plate stock for CNC machining the complex mid-frame geometry from solid. Near-net-shape forging for higher-volume production runs.
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC milling from plate (or near-net forging)
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 5, STA condition, 100% dimensional inspection, anodized / PVD finished
relatedCapabilities: CNC milling from plate (or near-net forging)
